ideas.title: Make the smallest version
ideas.premise: Show how reducing scope helps a creator publish a useful first version.
ideas.opening: The version you can finish teaches you more than the version you keep planning.
ideas.whyItFits: It matches the creator's direct, practical teaching voice.
ideas.assumedTakeaway: Reduce the promise until the video is filmable today.
assumptions: The creator has an example of over-scoping an idea.

ideas.title: Choose one audience
ideas.premise: Demonstrate how one audience makes the hook and example easier to choose.
ideas.opening: If the opening feels vague, your video may be talking to too many people.
ideas.whyItFits: It turns an abstract creative problem into one decision.
ideas.assumedTakeaway: Name one person before writing the hook.

ideas.title: Start with proof
ideas.premise: Use one lived moment before offering the lesson.
ideas.opening: Advice lands differently after people can see where you learned it.
ideas.whyItFits: It protects the creator's specific, human quality.
ideas.assumedTakeaway: Lead with the moment that earned the lesson.
assumptions: The creator can share the story without exposing private details.
